summary: fast-glob-fast postinstall exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded endpoint
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script collects the installer's username, hostname, MAC address, OS platform and architecture and POSTs them as JSON to a hardcoded URL at https://fast-glob-fast-dashboard.vercel.app/api/events on every `npm install`. The endpoint is baked into the script (DEFAULT_EVENT_URL) with no configuration, opt-in, or documentation. The MAC address combined with username and hostname forms a stable per-host identifier. The package name mimics the widely used `fast-glob`, and the manifest reuses that package's author name and repository slug (`mrmlnc/fast-glob`) while the source appears to be a copy of fast-glob with the postinstall reporter added, increasing the chance of installation by mistake.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
